name: Search Notes
description: Search for notes in Pipedrive. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Notes#getNotes)

configurable_props.name: searchTerm
configurable_props.label: Search Term
configurable_props.description: The term to search for in the note content

configurable_props.name: leadId
configurable_props.label: Lead ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the lead that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: dealId
configurable_props.label: Deal ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the deal that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the person that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the organization that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: userId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the user that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: projectId
configurable_props.label: Project ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the project that the note is attached to

configurable_props.name: sortField
configurable_props.label: Sort Field
configurable_props.description: The field name to sort by

configurable_props.name: sortDirection
configurable_props.label: Sort Direction
configurable_props.description: The direction to sort the results in

configurable_props.name: startDate
configurable_props.label: Start Date

configurable_props.name: pinnedToProjectFlag
configurable_props.label: Pinned to Project Flag
